{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp and chainparams.h only mechanically to add assumeutxo Merkle roots for the P2P protocol, with no kernel boundary or API changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not kernel work."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches validation.cpp trivially (+1/-0) with no relation to mempool policy, limits, or package relay.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not mempool work."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label and adds the NODE_UTXO_SET service bit and new P2P wire messages to query and fetch snapshot chunks.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds in-band P2P distribution for AssumeUTXO snapshots according to a draft BIP, significantly lowering onboarding friction for users currently forced to acquire snapshots out-of-band. Protocol extension requires deliberate review of DoS vectors and network resource usage."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements the new downloadutxoset RPC method in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to trigger asynchronous fetching and snapshot activation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds the `downloadutxoset` RPC method to initiate and manage background snapshot fetching and activation. It introduces a new control interface without breaking existing RPC methods."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes (test/functional/p2p_utxo_set_share.py, messages.py) specifically test the new P2P protocol and RPC rather than general test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Not test infrastructure work."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds contrib/utxo-tools/utxo_snapshot_merkle.py to support the PR's Merkle tree snapshot workflow, which is accessory tooling rather than core tooling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not tools work."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches logging and init files minimally to register the new logging category and initialize the background manager.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not utils work."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements snapshot activation pipelines and dual chainstate handling for assumeutxo, modifying src/consensus/merkle.cpp and coordinating with background chainstate validation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Deeply impacts assumeutxo workflows by triggering in-process snapshot activation and dual chainstate management. Reviewers in discussion heavily contested the validation complexity and maintenance burdens associated with dual chainstates across reorgs and pruning."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
